rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a permanent item attached to a house and included in its sale.

example.english: The fixture is included in the sale of this house.
example.traditional: 呢間屋連固定裝置都包埋喺買賣合約入面。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 lin4 gu3 ding6 zong1 zi3 dou1 baau1 maai4 hai2 maai5 maai6 hap6 joek3 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a lighting fixture rather than a general fixed house fitting.

example.english: The lighting fixture in the lobby needs to be replaced soon.
example.traditional: 大堂嘅燈具壞咗，要盡快更換。
example.jyutping: daai6 tong4 ge3 dang1 geoi6 waai6 zo2 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 gang1 wun6

rows.note: Use this for a scheduled sports match when the sporting context makes the meaning clear.

example.english: Tomorrow’s fixture has been moved forward by half an hour.
example.traditional: 聽日場比賽改咗時間，提早半個鐘開始。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 coeng4 bei2 coi3 goi2 zo2 si4 gaan1 tai4 zou2 bun3 go3 zung1 hoi1 ci2
